title: P1 v3: context economy telemetry — per-section token attribution, candidate vs presented, instruction tokens on every dispatch path, context derived inside log_run, packet-only fallback with a defined boundary (no behaviour change)
spec:
One behaviour: every model invocation's packet is measured per section (deterministic chars // 4 plus a sha256 per section) and logged, so the scorecard can show how many tokens each section costs per role and how often the same section text is re-sent across the roles working one goal. Nothing sent to any model changes.

Facts (verified 2026-09-22, main e8c4687): packets are assembled as named sections rendered "## <name>\n<body>" and start with the header line "packet v<hash> base <sha> sources ...": execute in spawn.py _packet_body (sections list spawn.py:287-323, joined at :317), review in review_packet (spawn.py:435-488 via _section; diff bounded by a budget), spec_review_packet (:494-512), scout_packet (:513-570); packet_run_meta (spawn.py:360-371) parses the header and records chars, est_tokens, hash, version; packet_meta (:355) is stored on the task and forwarded as the packet_meta kwarg by every log_run call site (executor.py:127/147/151, spawn.py run_claude/run_worker); the Codex execute path is daemon.py: _dispatch_fresh_fix (daemon.py:573-579) and the main dispatch loop (daemon.py:862-875) build packet and prompt separately, call spawn.packet_run_meta(packet) and hand prompt + packet_meta to executor.start via _dispatch_worker; spawn.run_worker renders prompt around packet for Claude roles (and the Claude execute fallback); executor.reply's direct-reply fallback sends repair = briefing + "\n\nRepair delta:\n" + delta (executor.py:421-425) and its resume branch a bare delta; executor._run (executor.py:116) and executor.start (executor.py:334) fall back to packet_run_meta(<text>) when packet_meta is missing; mcp.py codex()/codex_reply() call executor.start/reply with no packet_meta; bus.log_run (bus.py:278-335) appends one JSON line per run with role, tier, account, executor, task, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, usd, duration and the packet_meta dict; tasks carry parent (goal id); attribution.lineage (attribution.py:96-108) chains fix rounds only. Known duplication stays in place (P4 removes it after the baseline): spec/acceptance/scope appear twice in the execute prompt.

Decisions binding for this version (spec reviews T-0766 and T-0768):
A. Amplification: grouped by parent goal id; per-section map {section_name: total_tokens / unique_tokens} with unique = distinct sha256 within the group, plus the group scalar; lineage root recorded as a column only.
B. instruction_tokens = est_tokens(rendered_prompt) - est_tokens(packet), computed and merged into packet_meta at EVERY place a prompt is rendered around a packet: spawn.run_worker (Claude roles and the Claude execute fallback), daemon.py _dispatch_fresh_fix and the main dispatch loop (the Codex execute path; daemon.py is in scope), and any other render()+packet pairing found while implementing (name it in the result). packet_run_meta keeps one argument and measures packet text only.
C. bus.log_run derives context INTERNALLY from fields.get("packet_meta") (sections, presented_tokens, candidate_tokens, candidate_known, instruction_tokens, packet_version); context is None when packet_meta is absent or has no hash/version; no log_run call site changes.
D. Fallback boundary in executor._run/start when packet_meta is absent: the packet span is the text from the "packet v" header line up to (excluding) the first occurrence of "\n\nRepair delta:\n" when present, else to the end of the text; sections are parsed only inside that span, so a "## " line inside a repair delta or trailing template text never counts; text with no header yields context None (unmeasured). packet_meta, when present on the task, always wins over the fallback.

Do:
1. spawn.py: section_meta(text) splits on lines starting with "## " into {name: {"chars", "est_tokens" (chars // 4), "sha256"}} plus "_preamble"; packet_run_meta gains "sections" and "presented_tokens"; builders record "candidate_tokens" (execute body before the 4800-char cap; review diff before bounded_diff) and "candidate_known": false when a builder cannot know it; a helper `with_instruction_tokens(packet_meta, rendered_prompt, packet)` merges instruction_tokens, used by run_worker and the daemon paths.
2. daemon.py: _dispatch_fresh_fix and the main dispatch loop call with_instruction_tokens before handing packet_meta to the executor; no dispatch behaviour changes.
3. bus.log_run: decision C.
4. executor.py: decision D; the fallback helper `packet_span(text)` lives in spawn.py or executor.py (say which) with its own unit tests.
5. orchestrator/context_scorecard.py: build(root) -> {"roles": rows per role (runs, measured, unmeasured, avg presented, avg candidate, reduction_ratio, avg instruction_tokens, top sections by avg tokens), "goals": rows per goal id (runs, measured, amplification scalar, amplification_by_section, repeated_sections: names whose sha256 recurs across at least two roles, lineage roots)}; format_report; `orchestrator scorecard --context` in cli.py.
6. docs/context-economy/01-telemetry.md: fields, the chars // 4 convention, candidate vs presented, instruction tokens, amplification by goal, unmeasured rows, the fallback boundary rule.
7. Tests (unittest.TestCase, shared tests/_harness ORCH_ROOT): tests/test_spawn.py::test_section_meta_splits_named_sections; tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_run_meta_reports_sections_and_presented_tokens; tests/test_spawn.py::test_review_packet_records_candidate_tokens_before_diff_budget; tests/test_spawn.py::test_run_worker_records_instruction_tokens; tests/test_daemon.py::test_dispatch_records_instruction_tokens (the Codex dispatch path with the executor patched: packet_meta handed to executor.start carries instruction_tokens equal to rendered minus packet); tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_context_measures_only_the_packet; tests/test_executor.py::test_repair_delta_headings_are_not_packet_sections (repair text containing a "## " line after the delta marker: sections equal the bare packet's); tests/test_executor.py::test_bare_delta_yields_unmeasured_context; tests/test_bus.py::test_log_run_derives_context_from_packet_meta (with packet_meta: context populated; without: None); tests/test_context_scorecard.py::test_amplification_by_section_groups_by_goal (three runs of different roles under one goal sharing an identical spec section: spec 3.0, unique sections 1.0); tests/test_context_scorecard.py::test_rows_per_role_and_unmeasured_count.
Gate: .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0. Rendered prompts are byte-identical to before.
acceptance: orchestrator scorecard --context prints per-role and per-goal tables; docs/context-economy/01-telemetry.md exists; rendered prompts are byte-identical to before
